title: Student Technology Device Program Depreciation Schedule and Loss and Theft Terms
content:
For the Student Technology Device Program, a lost device and a device not returned are charged on a share of the replacement cost of a new device of the type, the share falling with the device's service year. Each loan type also states whether the Technology Protection Plan reduces the charge for a lost device, how a theft is treated, and how many years a device stays in service.

## Depreciation schedule (every loan type)

Share of the replacement cost of a new device of the type that is charged for loss or non-return, by the device's service year:

| Device service year | Share charged |
|---|---|
| 1 | 100 percent |
| 2 | 75 percent |
| 3 | 50 percent |
| 4 | 25 percent |

A device stays in service for 4 years before retirement on every loan type. Service year 1 is a new device.

## Loss and theft terms by loan type

| Loan type | Plan reduces the charge for a lost device | Share of the depreciated replacement cost charged for a lost device under the plan | Stolen device charged nothing under the plan when a police report is filed | Days after the theft to file the police report and give its number (theft date is day 0) | Theft treated as loss unless a police report number is given |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability) | No | 100 percent | No | 5 calendar days | Yes |
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Yes | 50 percent | Yes | 5 calendar days | Yes |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Yes | 50 percent | Yes | 5 calendar days | Yes |
| Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability) | No | 100 percent | No | 5 calendar days | Yes |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Yes | 50 percent | Yes | 5 calendar days | Yes |
| Mobile Hotspot Loan | No | 100 percent | No | 5 calendar days | Yes |

## Points of reading

- The depreciated replacement cost is the replacement cost of a new device of the type multiplied by the share in the depreciation schedule for the device's service year.
- The police report window counts calendar days after the theft with the theft date as day 0: a report number given on day 5 is inside the 5-day window; one first given on day 6 is outside it.
- On every loan type a theft is treated as a loss unless a police report number is given.

### Hypothetical figure

Taking a hypothetical replacement cost of 500.00 (not a schedule figure), the depreciated replacement cost is 500.00 in service year 1, 375.00 in service year 2, 250.00 in service year 3 and 125.00 in service year 4.
